text: TrickIntegrate[(1 - t)^(a * Epsilon - 1) g[t], t] does an integration trick for the definite integral of ((1-t)^{a \;\text{Epsilon}-1} g[t]) from 0 to 1, yielding g[1]/a/Epsilon + Hold[Integrate][(1-t)^{a Epsilon-1} (g[t]-g[1]),{t,0,1}]
TrickIntegrate[t^(a Epsilon-1) g[t], t] gives \frac{g[0]}{a \;\text{Epsilon}}+ Hold[Integrate][\(t^{a \;\text{Epsilon}-1}\) (g[t]-g[0]),{t,0,1}], provided g[1] and g[0] exist.
